subject: [SYNTHETIC] SECURITY REPORT – SUDAN –KHARTOUM: Crime
information: On 14 October, in Omdurman, Khartoum State, armed men stopped an NGO vehicle at an informal checkpoint and stole two phones and cash. No injuries were reported.
analysis: Informal checkpoints have increased on secondary roads in Omdurman.
advice: NGOs should use primary roads and travel in convoys of at least two vehicles.
